overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today across the Montrose High Elevation area, with scattered showers and cool temps keeping conditions in check.**
- Trend: danger rises to High Tuesday, eases midweek, then returns to High Saturday–Sunday as humidity falls toward 27%.
- Weather driver: showers and thunderstorms likely today (70% chance, high near 71) with gusty west winds to 30 mph, drying out by the weekend.
- Watchout status: 0 of 7 local thresholds met; no Red Flag Warning is currently posted for this area.
- Restrictions: Montrose County moved to Stage 1 Fire Restrictions effective September 4; Delta County downgraded from Stage 2 to Stage 1 restrictions on September 4; Ouray County rescinded Stage 2 and reinstated Stage 1 restrictions effective September 3. GMUG National Forests removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, while BLM's Uncompahgre Field Office lifted Stage 2 restrictions August 20, with Stage 1 remaining through December.
- Nearby fire: the Elk Fire (Hinsdale County, near the Gunnison line) is 73% contained at 7,257 acres, with full containment expected October 31.
